workflows.name: Quick answer
workflows.trigger: A question one bounded read answers: one file or symbol, one ticket, one message, one doc
needs: The connection that holds the answer

endpoints.outcome: A marked reply that names what it read

endpoints.when: The message asks nothing of you, as most messages in a watched channel don't

endpoints.outcome: The clone answers what it can and passes the rest to you
endpoints.when: More is needed and the asker may not ask for work

workflows.name: Research
workflows.trigger: A question that needs more than a quick read: tracing behaviour, comparing versions or dates, a failure, sources that disagree
needs: For a question about code, a folder linked on Settings
For an incident, read access to that environment's logs and data

endpoints.outcome: An answer from the worker's report, with its sources and what stays uncertain
endpoints.when: The worker could read what it needed

endpoints.outcome: The change goes on as work
endpoints.when: The report confirms a problem to fix and the requester may ask for work

endpoints.outcome: A blocked report, and you hear which connection to reconnect on Set up
endpoints.when: A sign-in is missing, expired or invalid

endpoints.outcome: A blocked report naming the missing tool, permission or environment access, which signing in again does not fix
endpoints.when: The worker lacks a tool, a grant or access to that environment

workflows.name: Your change to a document or ticket
workflows.trigger: Your own message, in your self-DM or with your icon, asks to create or change a Doc, Sheet, ticket or page
needs: Google Workspace, or Jira and Confluence, on Set up

endpoints.outcome: The change, and a reply saying what changed
endpoints.when: Your message in that turn asked for it

endpoints.outcome: Nothing changes, and the clone passes it on or asks you to ask in a message of your own
endpoints.when: Someone else asked, or the request came from an earlier turn

workflows.name: Work
workflows.trigger: A request for a change or other work, from you or someone you allow, that makes sense and is theirs to ask
needs: For work on code, a folder linked on Settings, with the remote its pull requests go to
The connectors the work reads, on Set up
workflows.review: None is built in. The clone can start a reviewer worker, and the request or a routine can ask for a review and name its model, such as GPT through OpenCode.

endpoints.outcome: An open pull request, not merged
endpoints.when: The work changed code in a folder whose remote workers may not merge in
Workers may merge in the folder's remote, and the request or your routines take the work that far

endpoints.outcome: The result, said once in the thread
endpoints.when: The work is done, including work with no repository, which runs in a scratch folder

endpoints.outcome: The step that depends on it waits, the rest goes ahead, and the thread hears who it waits on
endpoints.when: A contract, a value or another change it depends on hasn't landed

endpoints.outcome: No retry unless someone asks again, and whoever waits on it hears so
endpoints.when: You pause Misha or stop the worker

endpoints.outcome: The clone says it failed and stops
endpoints.when: A worker's run fails again after one retry

endpoints.outcome: A blocked report, and you hear which connection to reconnect on Set up
endpoints.when: A sign-in is missing, expired or invalid

endpoints.outcome: What their side needs, instead of a change
endpoints.when: The change is to someone else's repository, document or pull request and they have not approved it in their own message

endpoints.outcome: Refused: those stay yours, whoever asks
endpoints.when: The request is for staging, production or a release
A decision belongs to you or another owner
